experiments.title: Sponza · 中庭建筑骨架
experiments.note: 边界/失败实例：模型明显偏暗并出现结构错误。建筑骨架与常量材质近似；内部近距离相机与7328三角形不同于论文训练设置，训练资产关系未核实；不宣称严格OOD，也不独断失败原因。
experiments.error_note: 显示域误差固定色标[0,0.25]；本例58.23%像素达到色标上限。A/B同曝光，同EV=0/Reinhard/sRGB；未单独提亮预测。

metrics.display_transform: max(x,0), EV=0, channel-wise Reinhard x/(1+x), IEC sRGB transfer
metrics.psnr_ssim_domain: float32 display-transformed RGB, data_range=1, full image, no crop
metrics.ssim_settings: skimage defaults: 7x7 uniform window, sample covariance
metrics.error_color_saturation_note: error >=0.25 uses the maximum colormap color

inference.timing_scope: complete pipeline forward, both stages, fresh texture clone before timer; no concurrent Cycles task; no scene representation cache

reference_renderer.reference_implementation: official bpy_helper==0.0.8 materials and camera; preserved converter split OBJ import
reference_renderer.diffuse_alignment: constant colors quantized by floor(255*diffuse)/255 to match official OBJ/H5 converter
